notice: All records, environments and results are fictional evaluation data. Scores measure candidate relevance, not factual correctness, evidence validity or vulnerability confirmation. This small authored suite is not an independent production benchmark.

grading.0: Unrelated, redundant mirror, or insufficient to answer the specific query.
grading.1: Complementary context, including another environment or an opposing observation.
grading.3: Directly relevant material under the stated query conditions.
grading.mirrors: Generated mirrors receive no additional credit beyond their canonical record, so duplicate results consume the same top-5 budget. Explicit mirror requests are evaluated by their own block ID.
grading.empty_relevance: The corpus contains no answer; a returned candidate counts against strict no-answer accuracy, even when its topic is related.
